description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grains using Azure Storage backends (Table and Blob Storage). It defines test classes with fixtures to configure the test clusters, and includes test methods for grains with long and short names, verifying their echo and clear state functionalities.

classes.name: GenericGrainsInAzureTableStorageTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Table Storage grain types, includes fixture setup and test methods for grains with long and short names.

classes.name: GenericGrainsInAzureBlobStorageTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Blob Storage grain types, includes fixture setup and test methods for grains with long and short names.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up Azure test clusters with specific storage configurations for each test class.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add Azure storage providers.

classes.name: StorageSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add Azure Blob storage provider.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with specific storage provider configurators.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks that the environment is suitable for running tests, e.g., emulator is not used.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureTableStorage_LongNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method for a long-named grain using Azure Table Storage, verifies echo functionality.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureTableStorage_ShortNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method for a short-named grain using Azure Table Storage, verifies echo functionality.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureBlobStorage_LongNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method for a long-named grain using Azure Blob Storage, verifies echo functionality.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureBlobStorage_ShortNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method for a short-named grain using Azure Blob Storage, verifies echo functionality.
